    The local fullness step for a displayed right mesh #

    Ringel's standardness recursion chooses all arrows ending at one vertex as the occurrence components of a right almost-split sink. This file proves the two local facts needed by that recursion: those components reassemble to the supplied sink, and fullness at all strict predecessors extends to the current target.
